title_sq: Shitet, Apartament 3+1+2, Crystal Lake Residence, Farke
description_sq:
Disponojme per shitje Apartament me oborr ne nje nga Rezidencat me Elitare ne zonen e Farkes. 
Ndertesa 3 - kateshe, me arkitekture bashkekohore, pjese e nje kompleksi privat me siguri, mirembajtje dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi. Apartamenti eshte me pamje nga Liqeni i Farkes, mes gjelberimit dhe ajrit te paster. 
Të dhënat kryesore:
 • Sipërfaqe Apartamenti Bruto: 173.1 m²
 • Sipërfaqe Apartamenti Neto: 153.9 m²
 • Sipërfaqe Verande: 95.5 m²
 • Kati: 3
 Organizimi i brendshëm:
 • Ambjent Ndenje
 • Ambjent Ngrenie
 • Kuzhine
 • 3 Dhoma gjumi
 • 2 Tualete 
Karakteristika të veçanta:
 • Struktura e nderteses do te jete e realizuar prej betoni te armuar
 • Projektuar ne normat evropiane te projektimit antisizmik (EUROCODE 8)
 • I gjithe perimetri i apartamentit nga jashte, do te jete me fasade te ventiluar
 • Izolim termik dhe akustik
 • Aspirim
 • Parket AC4

title_en: For sale, Apartment 3+1+2, Crystal Lake Residence, Farke
description_en: We have for sale an apartment with a courtyard in one of the most elite residences in the Farka area. Building 3 - floors, with contemporary architecture, part of a private complex with security, maintenance and high quality construction. The apartment has a view of Lake Farka, between greenery and clean air. Main data: • Gross Apartment Area: 173.1 m² • Net Apartment Area: 153.9 m² • Veranda Area: 95.5 m² • Floor: 3 Internal organization: • Living Room • Dining Room • Kitchen • 3 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets Special features: • The structure of the building will be made of reinforced concrete • Designed according to European standards anti-seismic design (EUROCODE 8) • The entire perimeter of the apartment from the outside will have a ventilated facade • Thermal and acoustic insulation • Aspiration • AC4 parquet For more information, contact us!
